newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada buys Canadian dollars - traders. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada buys Canadian dollars - traders. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]

text.p: The Bank of Canada intervened and bought Canadian dollars for U.S. dollars as the currency traded around the C$1.3960 level, dealers said.
The intervention was through brokers and considered light as the currency weakened through key support.
Following the intervention, the Canadian dollar was trading at C$1.3950 (corrects figure) after opening at C$1.3926 and Tuesday's close of C$1.3905. Traders expect further losses.
The Bank of Canada does not comment on intervention.
